# Data Examples

表格和复杂数据组件先定义列、数据和 key，再处理分页、选择、展开等增强项。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Timeline

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/timeline/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/timeline/`.

Note: 需要 `items`。`pending` 在（反转后的）列表末尾再插一项。pending 文案走 `locale.timeline.pendingText`。审批配方 playground 在 `workflow-timeline` / `workflow-viewer` / `workflow-detail-shell`；本页 01–03 才是时间线骨架。

Vue: `<Timeline :items="items" />`

React: `<Timeline items={items} />`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
